title: Red panda holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q58 50 55 58' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='25' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='25' rx='11' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#FF8FA3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='20' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB3C1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <polygon points='62,38 66,38 64,41' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <!-- Red panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#E8871E'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#F2A65A'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='36' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='4.5' fill='#F2A65A'/>
  <!-- Face markings - white cheeks and brow -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='50' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#F5E6CA'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='54' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='54' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Eye patches (dark but lit) -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='46' rx='4.5' ry='4' fill='#5C2A0E'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='46' rx='4.5' ry='4' fill='#5C2A0E'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='34.8' cy='45' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='45' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='53' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#2B1B0E'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M37 55 Q40 58 43 55' stroke='#5C2A0E' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='68' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#C1440E' transform='rotate(-20 25 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='65' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#C1440E' transform='rotate(25 59 65)'/>
  <!-- Paw holding string -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='58' r='4' fill='#5C2A0E'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#C1440E'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='88' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5C2A0E'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='88' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5C2A0E'/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#F2A65A' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
